name: Code Quality Auditing, Complexity & Maintainability
purpose: Audit cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, code duplication, and maintainability metrics across polyglot codebases with deterministic static analysis gates, and produce prioritized remediation plans with before/after evidence.
inputs: Repository checkout at a pinned commit plus language toolchain versions
Lint and analysis configuration in force (.golangci.yaml, ruff, eslint, clippy)
Complexity ceilings and duplication thresholds from the Goal or team policy
Per-module churn and defect history for risk ranking
outputs: Ranked hotspot backlog with risk scores and file-level locations
Remediation slices with before/after complexity and duplication deltas
Audit report with totals, thresholds, and residual tech-debt items
stop_conditions: All functions at or below cyclomatic complexity 10 and duplication at or below 3 percent
Remaining hotspots formally accepted as tech-debt items with owner and revisit date
